name: one-day
description: Turn tasks into a One Day link. Nothing is sent anywhere: the tasks travel inside the link.
long_description:
One tool, make_one_day_link, puts tasks (with a note, sub-tasks, a day and a repeat) in a link that adds them to One Day, a calm to-do list that keeps your tasks in your browser. You open the link and confirm. The server runs on your computer, opens no network connection and keeps nothing.

Try: “Add to One Day: call the bank tomorrow, and water the plants every Tuesday and Friday.”

tools.name: make_one_day_link
tools.description: Turn tasks into a link that adds them to One Day once you open it and confirm.

app_url.title: One Day address
app_url.description: Where your One Day opens, starting with https://. Change it only for your own copy of One Day; left empty, links open getone.day.
